intro: DR Congo produces most of the world's cobalt, vital for phone and car batteries.

chapters.title: Minerals
text: The south produces about three-quarters of the world's cobalt and large amounts of copper. Coltan, gold and diamonds are mined too, sometimes funding armed groups.
Despite this wealth, most people are very poor.

chapters.title: Power
text: The Inga Falls could produce huge amounts of hydroelectricity.
